subject: FinBank: request for personnel & onboarding evidence (SOC2/SIG)
messages:
From: Laura Geller <laura.geller@finbank.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: FinBank InfoSec <infosec@finbank.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: personnel & onboarding evidence for SOC2/SIG review

Hi Chloe,

Thanks for taking this. As part of our SOC2 validation and SIG review for vendors that handle sensitive customer data, we need a scoped sample of personnel-related evidence focused on hiring/onboarding, background checks, training, and leaver/deprovisioning processes. Specifically we'd like:

- A small, redacted sample (5–10) of completed background check evidence for US-based engineers (names redacted; include check type and completion date)
- Training completion logs for security awareness and data handling for the last 12 months
- Onboarding manifest showing join date, role, access groups assigned, and first-manager approval for a sample cohort (Q4 2026 preferred)
- Description of offboarding/deprovisioning workflow and a timeline showing access removal for one recent leaver

We do not need PII; redacted PDFs or CSVs are fine. Can you confirm what you can provide and an ETA? We need this for an external assessment starting 2027-06-01.

Appreciate it,

Laura Geller
Senior InfoSec Analyst — Vendor Risk
FinBank
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Geller <laura.geller@finbank.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: personnel & onboarding evidence for SOC2/SIG review

Hi Laura — thanks for the detailed list. We're able to provide a scoped packet that meets those asks. High-level plan and ETA below: 

- Redacted background check samples: we will provide 6 samples with fields redacted except check type and date (deliverable: redacted_background_checks_sample.pdf) — ETA: 2027-05-22 EOD PT
- Training completion log: CSV export for last 12 months with completion timestamps and training IDs (deliverable: training_completion_log_2026.csv) — ETA: 2027-05-22 EOD PT
- Onboarding manifest (Q4 2026 cohort): CSV with join date, role, initial access groups, and manager approval timestamp (deliverable: onboarding_manifest_2026_q4.csv) — ETA: 2027-05-22 EOD PT
- Offboarding workflow & one recent example: narrative + timeline and console audit screenshot (we will redact usernames) — ETA: 2027-05-22 EOD PT

Internal notes: I'm opening an internal ticket (INFSEC-872) to coordinate redaction and exports. Mina, can HR pull the background-check redacted PDFs? Soojin, can Security export the training logs and the audit timeline snippet? Karthik, I'll own delivery to the FinBank mailbox and the Drive share.

If that timeline works for your assessor, we'll upload to a shared Drive folder and send the link and a delivery manifest.

Thanks,
